content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "Yes; the judge text decides the Isaiah 7:14 link by the sign's own silence on mechanism, a verse-level stating test rather than chain-against-chain footing.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "the sign itself does not state the mechanism.", "rule_words": "the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "never verse by verse: (1) a judge may not decide by asking whether the sign verse itself states the mechanism; (2) it only forbids requiring one contrary-stating verse, not noting a verse's silence.", "why": "The judge treats the sign's own failure to state the mechanism as decisive for UNDERDETERMINED, so it uses verse-by-verse silence instead of chain-against-chain footing."}
